**Job Description – Technical Project Manager**
**Company:**
Kanhasoft
  
  
**Experience:**
4+ Years
  
  
**Location:**
Ahmedabad (Work from Office)
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**Job Overview**
We are looking for an experienced Technical Project Manager with 4+ years of experience in managing IT software development projects, preferably in a service-based IT company.
  
  
The ideal candidate should have a strong technical background, excellent project management skills, and the ability to manage end-to-end project delivery. The candidate will be responsible for coordinating with clients, developers, QA teams, and other stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered within defined timelines, budgets, and quality standards.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Manage end-to-end software development projects, from requirement gathering to final delivery and maintenance.
* Understand client requirements, business workflows, and technical specifications.
* Coordinate with clients to gather requirements, provide project updates, and manage expectations.
* Prepare project plans, timelines, milestones, resource allocation, and delivery schedules.
* Manage and coordinate development teams, including Web Developers, Mobile Developers, UI/UX Designers, QA Engineers, and other technical resources.
* Monitor project progress, team performance, deliverables, and deadlines.
* Identify project risks, dependencies, bottlenecks, and proactively implement solutions.
* Conduct regular project meetings, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and review meetings.
* Ensure effective communication between clients, management, and internal development teams.
* Handle scope changes, change requests, and project documentation.
* Ensure projects meet quality standards and client expectations.
* Track project status using project management tools and provide regular reports to management.
* Resolve project-related issues and ensure smooth project execution.
* Manage multiple projects simultaneously while maintaining delivery quality and timelines.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 4+ years of experience in Technical Project Management or Software Project Management.
* Strong experience working in an IT service-based software development company.
* Good understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
* Knowledge of Agile, Scrum, and Waterfall methodologies.
* Experience in managing web and mobile application development projects.
* Good understanding of technologies such as PHP, Laravel, Python, Django, React, Node.js, .NET, Flutter, React Native, or similar technologies.
* Ability to understand technical requirements, architecture discussions, APIs, databases, and development workflows.
* Experience in client communication, requirement gathering, and stakeholder management.
* Hands-on experience with project management tools such as Jira, Trello, Asana, ClickUp, or Monday.com.
* Strong knowledge of project planning, estimation, resource allocation, and risk management.
* Excellent leadership, team management, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Strong verbal and written English communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience managing international clients, especially from the USA, Europe, or the Middle East.
* Experience handling multiple software development projects simultaneously.
* Experience managing CRM, ERP, E-commerce, Marketplace, Healthcare, or other business applications.
* Knowledge of API integrations, third-party integrations, and database concepts.
* Experience in client meetings, project demonstrations, and delivery presentations.
* Technical background as a Software Developer, Business Analyst, or Technical Lead will be an added advantage.
* PMP, Scrum Master, or other project management certifications will be an advantage.

Skills:- Project Management, PHP, Laravel, Django, React.js, JIRA, Trello, Customer Relationship Management (CRM) and Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)

title: Program Manager
description:
**Program Manager - General Projects**

**Location:**

Ahmedabad, Gujarat 

**Type of Position:**

Full-Time 

**About the Role:**

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Program Manager to provide comprehensive support and oversight for a range of general projects, with a particular focus on holistic rural development and health-related initiatives. Reporting directly to the Project Director, this position will leverage strategic, creative, and innovative skills to enhance existing project performance and address emerging challenges. The ideal candidate will work autonomously, exercising discretion and sound judgment on critical matters, to monitor and coordinate the organization's diverse projects. In this role, you will be required to provide expert-level project management and manage budgets ensuring proper allocation of resources. 

**Responsibilities:**

● Evaluate programs, functions, and procedures within the organization to ensure effective program implementation. Identify issues and develop alternative solutions.

● Review and analyze data related to a variety of projects to develop recommendations for achieving program goals. 

● Provide direction and support to project teams in various capacities, addressing technical and interpersonal needs, motivating team dynamics, and acting as a liaison, problem solver, and facilitator. 

● Perform the full range of the project management cycle – initiating, planning, executing, monitoring, and identifying leads for effective project implementation. 

● Lead the planning and operations for programs and functions. 

● Develop and manage program budgets, ensuring financial sustainability and compliance with organizational policies. 

● Develop and manage relationships with key stakeholders, including clients, partners, and internal teams. 

● Manage multiple contending priorities simultaneously in an exciting environment. 

● Monitor and track program execution to success by removing blockers and always find the path forward in challenging situations. 

● Ensure standard program management processes are utilized and adequate support to the project team by coordinating PM reviews, preparing & publishing PM metrics. 

● Identify and manage risks, and develop contingency plans to mitigate their impact.

**Qualification & Skills**

● Bachelor's degree (Master's preferred) and 3+ years relevant experience.

● Proven ability to prioritize, organize, and execute with professionalism and attention to detail. 

● Demonstrated experience in program management, ideally in rural development or health. 

● Strong project management and relevant technical skills. 

● Understanding of current technologies (e.g., AI/GenAI). 

● Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, manage multiple tasks, and work independently. 

● PMP certification (a plus).

title: Cluster Head
company: Jay Shree Krushna Concrete PVT LTD
description:
**Company Description**
Jay Shree Krushna Concrete Pvt. Ltd. is a leading provider of high-quality ready-mix concrete, construction aggregates, and customized concrete solutions across Rajkot, Ahmedabad, Baroda, and the wider Gujarat region. The company supports residential, commercial, roadway, and industrial projects with M20 and higher-grade concrete, precision-blended aggregates, and reliable logistics for on-time delivery. With strong emphasis on quality control, modern batching technology, and adherence to IS standards, the organization ensures durability and long-term performance in varied environmental conditions. A customer-first approach drives close collaboration with contractors, engineers, and developers to deliver tailored solutions from order to pour. The company also promotes sustainability by reducing material waste, conserving water, and supporting green construction practices, aiming to build long-term partnerships based on trust and efficiency.
  
**Role Description**
The Cluster Head role is a full-time, on-site position based in Ahmedabad, overseeing operations and performance across multiple plants or locations within the assigned cluster. The Cluster Head will manage daily production planning, resource allocation, logistics coordination, and delivery schedules to ensure quality concrete supply and timely service. This role includes monitoring key operational metrics, implementing process improvements, ensuring compliance with safety and quality standards, and resolving issues that may affect production or customer satisfaction. The Cluster Head will lead and mentor plant and field teams, work closely with sales and technical staff to meet project requirements, and maintain strong relationships with key clients and stakeholders. Regular reporting to senior management, budgeting support, and participation in strategic initiatives to improve efficiency and profitability are also core responsibilities.

* Strong operational management skills, including experience in production planning, logistics coordination, and multi-site supervision in construction materials or related industries.
* Knowledge of ready-mix concrete processes, quality control standards (preferably IS standards), and basic understanding of mix designs and batching technology.
* Proven leadership abilities, with experience in team management, performance monitoring, and mentoring staff at different levels.
* Customer relationship and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with contractors, engineers, developers, and internal teams.
* Analytical and problem-solving skills for handling operational challenges, optimizing resources, and supporting data-driven decision-making.
* Familiarity with safety regulations, compliance practices, and environmental considerations in plant operations.
* Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field; an MBA or postgraduate qualification is an advantage.
* Prior experience in ready-mix concrete, construction materials, or infrastructure projects, ideally in a supervisory or regional management role.
